doctor.summary: Probe Python runtime, SQLite FTS5, parsers, Excel engine, and optional Playwright/semantic dependencies without reading secrets.

validate.summary: Validate JSON artifacts against contracts/ schemas and cross-field semantic invariants.

sanitize-check.summary: Reject secret paths without opening them and scan allowed files for intranet IPs, personal paths, credentials, and blocklist terms.

run.summary: Initialize, inspect, or safely resume an external audit workspace with atomic checkpointing and Markdown views.

corpus.summary: Parse PDF/HTML/XLSX corpus documents into normalized glossary entries and chunks, then build rebuildable SQLite FTS5 index.

retrieve.summary: Query SQLite glossary + FTS5 (+ optional vector) using UI context and emit controlled evidence bundles.

review.summary: Prepare evidence packets for host LLM review, ingest decisions, verify citation integrity, and run concept-scoped cross-menu consistency checks.

export.summary: Export 6-column color-coded formula-safe Excel workbook with optional summary sheets and read-back verification.

verify.summary: Verify end-to-end delivery integrity, workbook read-back, row hashes, and coverage reconciliation.

evaluate.summary: Run golden-set evaluation and ablation comparisons across retrieval modes.

explore.summary: Run policy-constrained Playwright bilingual UI discovery with network isolation during thorough synthetic input probes.
